title: さよならを書き換える街
author: 群青 リク

prediction.question: 航平が手紙で示された場所はどこ？

en.title: The Town That Rewrites Farewells
en.premise: A strange will left by an old bookstore owner: a series of fragmented letters urging several strangers to gather at a specific location. Guided by these messages, people from all walks of life begin to trace the forgotten memories of their town. On the night of a lunar eclipse, in the place where their paths finally meet, lonely souls quietly intertwine.

zh.title: 重写告别的街道
zh.premise: 一位旧书店店主留下了奇妙的遗言。那是几封碎片般的手信，引导几位互不相识的居民聚集在“某个地方”。走在截然不同人生道路上的人们，在信件的指引下，开始追寻这座城镇被遗忘的记忆。月食之夜，在他们抵达的终点，孤独的灵魂静静地交汇。
